results.title: Capsize
results.overview: In search of freedom, our two sidekicks decide to go on a pedal boat.

results.title: The Last Blossom
results.overview: An elderly inmate serving a life sentence awaits a lonely death in solitary—until a voice calls out to him. It belongs to a balsam flower, Housenka, that speaks like a human. Through their 'conversation', the old man reflects on the life he's led.

results.title: Sign Language
results.overview: Convinced that a museum art sculpture is misaligned, a determined tourist challenges the gallery’s security protocols in an attempt to adjust the positioning of the central piece.

results.title: Recao
results.overview: An intimate story about the unconditional love between a granddaughter and her grandfather, shaped by nostalgia, local traditions, and the things we lose with time.

results.title: Midnight Coachmen
results.overview: A reimagining of a classic fairytale, told from the perspective of a dog and mouse who live as humans until the stroke of midnight disrupts their world.

results.title: Snow Falling on Pumpkins
results.overview: When Michael is diagnosed with early-onset Alzheimer's at 43, his world begins to unravel. Searching for meaning, he finds healing in the wisdom of a Cherokee spiritual guide and the unwavering love of James, the man who becomes his husband. As memories slip away, Michael discovers that love is the one thing time cannot erase.

results.title: Queerbait
results.overview: A precocious classics student piques the interest of his tenured professor. But when his mentorship starts to push boundaries, he's forced to make a choice: protect his academic future, or protect his dignity?

results.title: Sisterhood, Inc.
results.overview: After Megan, an ambitious CEO, loses her job, she assembles a corporate-style board of directors to manage her sister's disordered, chaotic life — and uncovers revelations of her own.

results.title: Paradies 2030
results.overview: Now that most public ambulances have been phased out, Lu works as a "rescue pirate," using her converted van as an ambulance.

results.title: Gayong
results.overview: Biography about the late great Dato' Meor Abd Rahman, grandmaster and founder of Silat Gayong Malaysia.

results.title: NJPW World Tag League 2025 - Day 14
results.overview: The fourteenth night of the World Tag League 2025 heavyweight tag team tournament took place on December 9, 2025, at Iizuka City General Gymnasium in Iizuka, Fukuoka, Japan.

results.title: Dissecando Selma
results.overview: A director starts from a disturbing provocation to explore, in the tone of a fable, the boundaries between motherhood, desire, and identity. At the center is Selma, a mother consumed by jealousy, who spirals into delusions and imagined rivalries after discovering signs of her son's sexual life.

results.title: Density
results.overview: A narcotic noir Short Film following the destructive path of 4 flatmates, desperately seeking to enhance their fincancial and psychoactive situation. AKA: Oceans Eleven gone wrong between four unsuccessful Roommates.

results.title: Puddle Man
results.overview: Toby is a twelve-year-old boy who is evacuated to Dartmoor in the midst of the Second World War. With new fears looming over him, Toby discovers his grandmother Julie’s dark past and a mysterious figure who wanders the moorland.

results.title: The Banished
results.overview: Grace has nowhere to turn when she finds herself lost in the wilderness with a dark presence threatening to consume her in this twisted folk horror.

results.title: Someone Like Me
results.overview: A young woman living with cerebral palsy discovers newfound independence and self-acceptance through her encounters with a specialized organization that helps people with disabilities explore their sexuality.

results.title: The Painting
results.overview: Utilising the Alexeïeff-Parker pinscreen technique, this visually poetic non-narrative film revisits Diego Vélasquez’s 1652 portrait of Queen Mariana of Austria with genuine feeling.

results.title: Boo-Yah: A Portrait of Stuart Scott
results.original_title: Boo-Yah: A Portrait of Stuart Scott
results.overview: "Boo-Yah" traces Stuart's journey from local television in North Carolina to becoming one of ESPN's most influential voices. At a time when hip-hop and popular culture were often marginalized in mainstream media and few Black anchors held national prominence, Stuart brought both unapologetically to "SportsCenter," blending sharp analysis, pop culture and swagger in a way that spoke to a new generation of fans.

results.title: Pools
results.overview: Kennedy has one day to get her shit together or get kicked out of school for good. Instead of buckling down, she rallies a ragtag crew for a midnight pool-hopping adventure through the lavish estates of her college town. But under the surface, Kennedy is searching for answers to the questions tearing her up inside in the wake of her father's death. As the secrets spill, this wild escape becomes a cathartic journey of self-discovery.
